issues.description: The shared tool locator gives environment paths precedence over fixed repository hints, allowing stale external Verus or Z3 binaries to displace the repository toolchain; the selected problem commit broadens, but does not introduce, this behavior.
issues.rationale: At d6659b1d, locate tries a valid environment candidate before repository hints for both Verus and Z3. When tools/verus is present but VERUS_PATH or VERUS_Z3_PATH names another valid installation, the external candidate wins. The same problem commit derives the Verus source root and root-relative Z3, line-count, and verusdoc locations from the selected Verus binary, expanding the consequence of the pre-existing precedence. Repair 330b824b tries repository hints first, then environment, then PATH, preserving environment variables as fallbacks.
issues.introduction_provenance: Environment-first locate already exists at base d67afbc9. The problem snapshot is the immediate in-PR predecessor of the repair and broadens the affected derived-tool surface; it is not claimed as the first introduction.
